title: Learning Human-like Representations to Enable Learning Human Values

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating an AI agent's ability to safely learn and generalize 10 distinct human values (such as morality, fairness, honesty, and compassion) by using aggregated human value judgments as rewards in a multi-armed bandit reinforcement learning setting.

Measuring the Spearman correlation between pairwise similarity judgments of 50 textual action descriptions generated by various language models and the baseline similarity judgments provided by human evaluators.
